notes: You can ask your servicer in writing to cancel PMI once the balance is 80% of the original value, earlier if you pay extra. You need a good payment history, no second mortgage, and possibly an appraisal showing the value hasn't fallen. It ends on its own when the balance is scheduled to reach 78%, and at the loan's halfway point at the latest (CFPB).
For 2026, PMI counts as deductible mortgage interest if you itemise and your AGI is $100,000 or less (phased out up to $109,000). The plan doesn't take that into account.

FHA mortgage insurance doesn't end at 80% or 78%. For FHA loans from 3 June 2013 it runs 11 years if you borrowed 90% or less of the home's value, otherwise for the loan's term (HUD). Refinancing to a conventional loan is the usual way out; that's a big decision with its own costs.
